race.comment: ALL OVER HARRY (4) showed pace and battled on well for a close second when resuming over 1300m at Newcastle two back. Well supported in town subsequently but finished last and was suffering from cardiac arrhythmia. Big chance if everything is spot on today. ARRUZA (5) moved up into a handy position on the turn but failed to run on over this trip at Rosehill on debut 24 days ago. Tackles a much easier race today and gets a gun run from the nice draw. Import SUR NOVA CENTAURI (3) has transferred to Waterhouse/Bott and been gelded since his only Australian run back in May, a failure over 1500m at Newcastle. Placed at all three runs in the UK, two at this trip. Expecting a lot more now. BAVARIA (6) is a Snitzel colt on debut for Ciaron Maher. Has been to the trials numerous times and shows ability. Market will be the best guide. HUSSLAA (7) was a bit plain at Kembla last start but can improve at the third run back.
